name: Jelly Sauce
description: Historical recipe from The Whitehouse Cookbook (1887). Source method; not modernized or kitchen-tested.

ingredients.name: half a cupful of water or wine
ingredients.originalText: half a cupful of water or wine
ingredients.quantityText: half a cupful of water or wine

instructions.text: Melt the sugar and jelly over the fire in a cupful of boiling water, adding also two tablespoonfuls of butter
Stir into it a teaspoonful of cornstarch, dissolved in half a cupful of water or wine
Add it to the jelly and let it come to a boil
Set it in a dish of hot water to keep it warm until time to serve

source.author: F.L. Gillette
source.originalInstructions:
1. Melt the sugar and jelly over the fire in a cupful of boiling water, adding also two tablespoonfuls of butter
2. Stir into it a teaspoonful of cornstarch, dissolved in half a cupful of water or wine
3. Add it to the jelly and let it come to a boil
4. Set it in a dish of hot water to keep it warm until time to serve
5. Stir occasionally
